does: Rolls the check of a stats roll expression node (the RollDefinition of an ability check, a save or a skill check of a roll request): resolves roller and target, their boosts and difficulty, and throws it either as an ability roll (0x1187FE0) or a skill roll (0x11888B0).

evidence.says: reads a RollDefinition, eoc::DifficultyCheckComponent, StatsComponent and BoostsContainerComponent, calls 0x1187FE0 or 0x11888B0
a concentration save passes it at +0x1189DB0; a dialogue check and a story passive check pass it at +0x1189C7D
